I’m happy to help you figure out whether your vehicle has enough range for the planned trip!

Because I don’t have direct access to your car’s real‑time data, it would be great if you could share:
* Your current fuel level (in gallons or percent full)
* Your vehicle’s average fuel economy (miles per gallon)

With those numbers I’ll calculate how far you can safely drive before needing another refuel, compare that against the estimated 750 mi round‑trip, and let you know if you’re good to go—or if you’d want to stop at a nearby gas station en route. If you prefer not to disclose exact figures, just give an approximate mpg rating and a sense of how much fuel remains (e.g., “about half a tank”). That’ll still allow us to make a reasonable assessment.

messages:
ChatCompletionMessage(content='I’m happy to help you figure out whether your vehicle has enough range for the planned trip!

Because I don’t have direct access to your car’s real‑time data, it would be great if you could share:
* Your current fuel level (in gallons or percent full)
